his_versions.68752b7e (Human Written; windows Human H: When too much hits you at once, your nervous system can become flooded, nothing makes sense, and we call it a bad trip. I might feel in the moment like  you're damaged for good, no that you're being punished for being spiritually impure. But more likely factors include the dose of what drug(s) you took and how your body handles them. Old painful memories could have been triggered, or you may have gone in with a fearful mindset, or the setting or people around you could have fed into it. Be kind about it, to yourself or to whoever's going through it, because blaming anyone only makes it heavier.
